item.title: Snapshot: ‘Black Artivists Experience’ in Kingston
item.description: The “Black Artivists Experience” was in full swing at the Center for Creative Education in Kingston, N.Y., on Saturday, Feb. 28, 2026. The event celebrates the depth, brilliance, and diversity of the Black community through music, dance, storytelling, poetry, and visual expression. (Connor Greco/Daily Freeman)

item.title: Kingston baseball team schedules pancake breakfast
item.description: KINGSTON, N.Y. — A pancake breakfast to benefit the Kingston High baseball team will be held from 8 a.m. to noon on Sunday, March 22 at Ulster Hose at 830 Ulster Ave., Kingston, N.Y. The price is $10 per person.
